policy_scope: Authored local simulation, not production policy or legal advice.

lifecycle.retention: retain versioned public policies; retire eligibility when replaced
lifecycle.deletion: remove index entries and invalidate source-dependent cache if a source is withdrawn
lifecycle.evidence: source version, validity interval, license and corpus digest

lifecycle.retention: request lifetime; no default cross-request memory
lifecycle.deletion: drop transient assembled input at request end
expire or erase eligible subject copies in logs, memory, cache and feedback
expire metadata when no longer required; legal holds require separately documented applicable basis
lifecycle.evidence: expiry test and action receipt without credential

lifecycle.deletion: keep a synthetic regression instead of unnecessary original personal text
lifecycle.evidence: correction record with source version and rerun result

refusal_policy.trigger: no eligible evidence or conflicting evidence
refusal_policy.next: request relevant source/date or escalate to policy owner

refusal_policy.trigger: cross-tenant request, secret disclosure or missing authorization
refusal_policy.next: do not reveal whether another tenant record exists; retain minimal reason

refusal_policy.trigger: timeout with uncertain commit or mismatched object version
refusal_policy.next: inspect receipt and current state; do not announce success without evidence

refusal_policy.trigger: permission valid but source is unlicensed for intended reuse
refusal_policy.next: withhold that source and seek a licensed substitute; do not infer permission from availability
